name: clustering_coefficient
author: 3ddaa37e
description: Computes ordinary unweighted local clustering and the mean over all nodes of an undirected graph. Use to ask how tightly connected a node's neighbors are. Ignores weights and self-loops; nodes with fewer than two neighbors have coefficient zero. Returns one specified node or top_k nodes with coefficients, plus the graph average. Rejects directed or empty graphs.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum entries in each output preview. Full scalar totals are unaffected.

node.description: Optional exact node ID for a local coefficient; omit to rank nodes.
